content:
Alex M.: Heads up — getting cross-team reports of 502s from a couple of customers (acme-corp, beta-ops). Our incident automation posted a message in #incidents but did NOT page oncall. Anyone oncall? @SRE-Bot, did the webhook fire?

SRE-Bot: automation webhook received: 2023-08-11T14:12:09Z, but incident creation API returned 422. Error: "sigil mismatch". Fallback attempted to post a channel-only thread.
```
{"event":"webhook.received","status":422,"detail":"sigil mismatch for X-Sigil header"}
```

Priya S.: Jordan — can you pick this up? If automation didn't page we should do manual paging and customer callbacks.

Jordan L.: Oncall here, paging now. /page @oncall-squad — manual page sent. I'll take lead.

Alex M.: Customer Ops says both customers started seeing errors ~14:12 UTC, impacting API calls to inference endpoints (timeout/502). Could be related to integration signing.

Priya S.: Looking at the ingress logs: recent key rotation pushed a new signing key but the automation service still sends the old sigil. Quick repro:
```bash
# simulate webhook header
curl -v -H "X-Sigil: old-sigil-123" https://ingest.redwood.example/webhook || true
# returned 422 with sigil mismatch
```
I can push a short-term allowlist to accept both sigils while we roll the automation.

SRE-Bot: Note — fallback to channel-only posting is observed when `page_on_create=false`. The automation didn't flip `page_on_create` because the create call errored before storing metadata. Also saw a rate-limit on manual pages for this window (throttle policy applied).

Jordan L.: Acknowledged. I'll create an incident record manually and start mitigation. @Priya, please share the allowlist key when ready so I can validate customer traffic. I'll also open the bridge with COps for customer callbacks.

Priya S.: Hotfix pushed: updated integrations table to accept legacy sigil for 30m while we update automation. Quick test against staging: 200 OK and incident created.
```
POST /internal/incidents  -> 201 created
ingest webhook -> 200 OK
```

SRE-Bot: Ingestion test succeeded, incident created and page delivered :thumbsup:. Logging: `ingest.accepted=true, create.incident=201, page_sent=true`

Customer Ops: I've messaged acme-corp and beta-ops with a brief status update and ETA ~30m for fix. Both want regular updates; no formal P1 yet but they are escalated internally.

Alex M.: Root cause summary for postmortem: signing key rotation + missing rollout hook in automation caused `X-Sigil` validation to fail and prevented automated paging. Action items: (1) add pre-rotation validation + rollout check, (2) make automation create-and-page idempotent so a create error doesn't swallow paging flag, (3) add alert for repeated 422s from webhook endpoint. Filing follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2026

Jordan L.: Marking incident as mitigated for now. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and update if we see regressions. Thanks everyone for quick triage.

Alex M.: Thanks — please post the final timeline to the incident doc once it's closed. :white_check_mark:
